title: result payload
description: A reported measurement. Every field that scopes the measurement is part of its identity, because ER-06 forbids comparing results obtained under different conditions.

dataset.description: The benchmark. Two numbers from different datasets are not comparable at all.

split.description: e.g. newstest2014, dev, test. Dev and test scores differ routinely and are not in conflict.

model_variant.description: e.g. base, large. A base model scoring lower than a large one is expected, not contradictory.

conditions.description: Protocol details the paper states: beam size, length penalty, number of runs.

reported_variance.description: Standard deviation or half-interval where the paper gives one. Two results whose intervals overlap are not contradictory.
